title: GTA VI features an in-game smartphone
excerpt: Grand Theft Auto VI incorporates a smartphone as a central object that exists within the game world to simulate modern life.
body_html: Grand Theft Auto VI is designed to simulate real-life elements, including the integration of a smartphone as a central part of the experience. According to details about the game, the device is treated as an object that physically exists within the game world, reflecting how essential smartphones are in modern daily life.
